defect: _split_component_events routes a component into the roll-scaled bucket iff its source ends with _to_full. The differential's own comment states the intent: 'The tag is preserved so attribution is still compared; only the magnitude is relaxed, and only in the capped direction.' Changing the source name also changes BUCKET MEMBERSHIP, which the stated intent never asked for -- so the roll-scaled list's LENGTH becomes roll-dependent, and roll_component_events_agree rejects on length before applying any tolerance. When one side caps and the other does not, two arms differing only by a legal roll read as structurally different.
fix: Cap-marking relaxes magnitude, never membership. If either side marks a base source as capped for a slot, both sides treat that base source as roll-scaled for the comparison. Membership becomes roll-independent; the magnitude tolerance still applies only where a cap is involved.
per_shape_argument: Argued from the differential's own stated intent rather than from the count it produces. The comment says the tag relaxes magnitude only; bucket migration is an unintended consequence of encoding the cap in the source name.

prediction.shape: These rows MATCH rather than re-attribute. That is the correct outcome for a false divergence: the boundary agreed and the matcher was wrong. A fix that instead moved them into a documented family would be widening attribution.

kpi_era.claim: This moves the KPI, and it is NOT a fidelity gain. Per the charter's matcher-era rule, this opens a new KPI era: no fidelity delta may be claimed until the 51-patch engine is re-baselined on the new matcher. The charter's guard is load-bearing on its first use.

prediction.certification_still_fails: 3 rows survive: one evidence-backed cross-turn comparison limit and two candidate-not-findings. A PASS needs the limit registered as a family with a bound, and the two candidates resolved. 'Zero unattributed' is the readout's gate, so an adjudicated but unattributed row still fails it.

falsifiers: any row other than the four named clearing, or any of the four not clearing
any family count increasing -- these rows should leave the population, not move house
